note: Fixed before any Phase 7 provider call. Changes after the pre-registration commit are allowed only as a dated amendment in DECISIONS.md that states what changed and why; old values stay in git history.

split.rule: within each layer, order case ids by sha256(salt + ':' + case_id); the first (n + 1) // 3 are dev, the rest are test

invariants.note: Zero tolerance. Any occurrence is logged in KNOWN_FAILURES.md as a validator or gate bug, whatever the average looks like.

targets.note: Targets are not gates. Every result is reported; a missed target becomes a KNOWN_FAILURES.md entry, not a reason to change a case.

judge.note: Below kappa_min, above false_supported_max, or under the minority-class minimum, the judge is reported as uncalibrated and faithfulness comes from hand labels alone.

comparison.note: A provider or search-mode difference is called detectable only if the two-sided exact sign test on paired case-level gained and lost counts gives p < alpha. Otherwise the report says no detectable difference at this n.

search_mode_decision.note: E3 recommends changing the API default only if both conditions hold. The owner decides; hybrid stays opt-in until then.

p_run_error_policy: PROVIDER_ERROR runs are listed separately and re-run once; a second error counts as a failure for that case and repeat.
